title: add context handoff regression gate and paired-window eval CI hook
author: Priya Anand
description: Add a new CI gate that verifies cross-window/context continuity for prompt sets when model serving parameters change (context window, model variant, or chunking strategy). Motivation: a common regression class we've observed is that answers drift or lose context continuity when requests are chunked or when traffic is routed to a different context-window-optimized variant. This PR implements a paired-window evaluation hook that runs a short-window and a long-window evaluation pass over overlapping prompt shards and computes a handoff_consistency score and context_loss metric. The hook can be attached as a soft or hard gate in pipeline configs. Highlights: - new metric: handoff_consistency (0-1, higher is better) - new secondary metric: context_loss (average semantic divergence normalized by length) - CI hook: ci/hooks/context_handoff_gate.py (configurable thresholds, sampling params) - eval implementation: evals/handoff_metric.py (modular scorer, supports embedding similarity and token-overlap backoff) - quicklocal test runner: scripts/eval_handoff_local.sh - small docs update and a smoke test that exercises an end-to-end paired run. The description below summarizes commits, changed files, test signals, and review discussion.

review_comments: Ethan Collins: Nice addition. A couple of questions: how do you pick overlapping shards so this won't bias towards trivial overlaps? Also can we guard the gate to be a soft-fail during rollout?

Priya Anand: Added entropy floor and embedding-based fallback for repetitive short responses. Unit tests added for edge cases.
